inventory.visualPurpose: Sphingolipid metabolism pathway with numbered blocks
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 86 ceramide-centered map: GM2 → GM3 (① hexosaminidase A, Tay-Sachs), ceramide trihexoside (② α-galactosidase A, Fabry), GM3 → glucocerebroside, glucocerebroside → ceramide (⑤ Gaucher), sphingomyelin → ceramide (⑥ Niemann-Pick), sulfatide/cerebroside sulfate → galactocerebroside (③ MLD), galactocerebroside → ceramide (④ Krabbe).

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: Cherry-red spot of Tay-Sachs and Niemann-Pick
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 86 fundus photograph (label A, printed in both the Tay-Sachs and Niemann-Pick rows): red-tinted macula surrounded by retinal opacification from lipid accumulation in the ganglion cell layer.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 86 clinical photograph (label B): punctate red-blue vascular skin lesions in the bathing-suit distribution.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: Gaucher cells: crumpled tissue paper macrophages
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 86 histology image (label C): lipid-laden macrophages with characteristic crumpled-tissue-paper cytoplasm in marrow/spleen.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 86 histology image (label D): foamy lipid-laden macrophages with vacuolated cytoplasm (sphingomyelin).

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 86 disease table: DISEASE / FINDINGS / DEFICIENT ENZYME / ACCUMULATED SUBSTRATE / INHERITANCE across Tay-Sachs, Fabry, MLD, Krabbe, Gaucher, Niemann-Pick, Hurler, Hunter, with the Hunters-see-clearly mnemonic.
